author: Nicolai156
body:
- Username: Nicolai156

- Rules i broke: Hacked Client which included: Fly and Speed. I were also caught ban evading on fellow accounts, (McFanta (My Original Account) (Chle_ (My friend but he got unbanned) (Krisdenkule8 (My alt/Originally my brother owns that account). I have also been caught lying on appeals twice or three times if I remember so. So I have broked so many rules that I may not be appealed because since I were banned my behavior was terrible. I may not be appealed because you may not trust me after my terrible bahavior but I will give this server a chance and never break rules gain hopefully :)!

- Why should I be appealed/unbanned?: Well usually this account Nicolai156 is basicly my original account McFanta's Alt. Also i really want to help the community that is dying and reasons why I want to help the community is to bring it back were it was because it makes me very upset that the community is dying. I really love the server even I am banned and I have broked so many rules and lied to staff but still the community is cool and kind so I really want to get back to Avicus and get it back to life and make sure I don't break so many rules again or Never again!! The reasons why my appeals has been denied so many times is of course I've lied to the senior is my appeals twice or more if I remember. Also i really want the accounts I ban evaded on to be unbanned because usually my original account McFanta_ is the owner of the Nicolai156 Account also I hope my brother Krisdenkule8 can be unbanned so he can play to. I am very sorry for everything I have done like I've lied to the staff many times and ban evaded and hacked. I really want a second chance on Avicus. It has been six months so I hope I can hopefully be unbanned on all of my accounts if you guys trust me. I will never ever hack or ban evade again or lie to staff again. You may not believe me though. If you don't. I understand. But I really hope I could get a second chance on Avicus and save the community and play of course. Because I like all of you guys in the community :)! Also my ban wasn't false all of the terrible things I did is true so no joke. I have been waiting about six months since all of my terrible behavior started to get banned. Yes as I told you I have been caught lying to staff and ban evading three times!! I have tried to appeal a ban many times but I have been denied in all of them. Reasons: Well I have lied in a couple of them. I am very sorry for all the shitty things I have done to Avicus and I really want to get a new start on Avicus and be unbanned on my real account McFanta_! Regards Nicolai156 Aka my real account www.avicus.net/McFanta_         Bye I hope you understand! If you don't I will clearly understand.
